verdict.rationale: LaunchDarkly documents a Bayesian statistics approach for experiment decisions ('Decision making with Bayesian statistics'), alongside first-party Experimentation docs and A/B tests listed on pricing, so a documented statistics engine stands behind results. The evidence consists only of page titles, and nothing mentions variance-reduction options such as CUPED or covariate adjustment, which the story explicitly asks for. Missing for 10: variance-reduction options, any frequentist or sequential-testing option, in-depth detail on the methodology, independent or hands-on corroboration of result trustworthiness.
